arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ يس
transliteration: Yaseen
translation: Ya Sin

arabic: وَالقُرءانِ الحَكيمِ
transliteration: Waalqurani alhakeemi
translation: By the wise Qur'an

arabic: إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ المُرسَلينَ
transliteration: Innaka lamina almursaleena
translation: Lo! thou art of those sent

arabic: عَلىٰ صِرٰطٍ مُستَقيمٍ
transliteration: AAala siratin mustaqeemin
translation: On a straight path

arabic: تَنزيلَ العَزيزِ الرَّحيمِ
transliteration: Tanzeela alAAazeezi alrraheemi
translation: A revelation of the Mighty, the Merciful

arabic: لِتُنذِرَ قَومًا ما أُنذِرَ ءاباؤُهُم فَهُم غٰفِلونَ
transliteration: Litunthira qawman ma onthira abaohum fahum ghafiloona
translation: That thou mayst warn a folk whose fathers were not warned, so they are heedless

arabic: لَقَد حَقَّ القَولُ عَلىٰ أَكثَرِهِم فَهُم لا يُؤمِنونَ
transliteration: Laqad haqqa alqawlu AAala aktharihim fahum la yuminoona
translation: Already hath the judgment, (for their infidelity) proved true of most of them, for they believe not

arabic: إِنّا جَعَلنا فى أَعنٰقِهِم أَغلٰلًا فَهِىَ إِلَى الأَذقانِ فَهُم مُقمَحونَ
transliteration: Inna jaAAalna fee aAAnaqihim aghlalan fahiya ila alathqani fahum muqmahoona
translation: Lo! We have put on their necks carcans reaching unto the chins, so that they are made stiff-necked

arabic: وَجَعَلنا مِن بَينِ أَيديهِم سَدًّا وَمِن خَلفِهِم سَدًّا فَأَغشَينٰهُم فَهُم لا يُبصِرونَ
transliteration: WajaAAalna min bayni aydeehim saddan wamin khalfihim saddan faaghshaynahum fahum la yubsiroona
translation: And We have set a bar before them and a bar behind them, and (thus) have covered them so that they see not

arabic: وَسَواءٌ عَلَيهِم ءَأَنذَرتَهُم أَم لَم تُنذِرهُم لا يُؤمِنونَ
transliteration: Wasawaon AAalayhim aanthartahum am lam tunthirhum la yuminoona
translation: Whether thou warn them or thou warn them not, it is alike for them, for they believe not

arabic: إِنَّما تُنذِرُ مَنِ اتَّبَعَ الذِّكرَ وَخَشِىَ الرَّحمٰنَ بِالغَيبِ فَبَشِّرهُ بِمَغفِرَةٍ وَأَجرٍ كَريمٍ
transliteration: Innama tunthiru mani ittabaAAa alththikra wakhashiya alrrahmana bialghaybi fabashshirhu bimaghfiratin waajrin kareemin
translation: Thou warnest only him who followeth the Reminder and feareth the Beneficent in secret. To him bear tidings of forgiveness and a rich reward

arabic: إِنّا نَحنُ نُحىِ المَوتىٰ وَنَكتُبُ ما قَدَّموا وَءاثٰرَهُم وَكُلَّ شَيءٍ أَحصَينٰهُ فى إِمامٍ مُبينٍ
transliteration: Inna nahnu nuhyee almawta wanaktubu ma qaddamoo waatharahum wakulla shayin ahsaynahu fee imamin mubeenin
translation: Lo! We it is Who bring the dead to life. We record that which they send before (them, and their footprints. And all things We have kept in a clear Register)

arabic: وَاضرِب لَهُم مَثَلًا أَصحٰبَ القَريَةِ إِذ جاءَهَا المُرسَلونَ
transliteration: Waidrib lahum mathalan ashaba alqaryati ith jaaha almursaloona
translation: Coin for them a similitude: The people of the city when those sent (from Allah) came unto them

arabic: إِذ أَرسَلنا إِلَيهِمُ اثنَينِ فَكَذَّبوهُما فَعَزَّزنا بِثالِثٍ فَقالوا إِنّا إِلَيكُم مُرسَلونَ
transliteration: Ith arsalna ilayhimu ithnayni fakaththaboohuma faAAazzazna bithalithin faqaloo inna ilaykum mursaloona
translation: When We sent unto them twain, and they denied them both, so We reinforced them with a third, and they said: Lo! we have been sent unto you

arabic: قالوا ما أَنتُم إِلّا بَشَرٌ مِثلُنا وَما أَنزَلَ الرَّحمٰنُ مِن شَيءٍ إِن أَنتُم إِلّا تَكذِبونَ
transliteration: Qaloo ma antum illa basharun mithluna wama anzala alrrahmanu min shayin in antum illa takthiboona
translation: They said: Ye are but mortals like unto us. The Beneficent hath naught revealed. Ye do but lie

arabic: قالوا رَبُّنا يَعلَمُ إِنّا إِلَيكُم لَمُرسَلونَ
transliteration: Qaloo rabbuna yaAAlamu inna ilaykum lamursaloona
translation: They answered: Our Lord knoweth that we are indeed sent unto you

arabic: وَما عَلَينا إِلَّا البَلٰغُ المُبينُ
transliteration: Wama AAalayna illa albalaghu almubeenu
translation: And our duty is but plain conveyance (of the message)

arabic: قالوا إِنّا تَطَيَّرنا بِكُم لَئِن لَم تَنتَهوا لَنَرجُمَنَّكُم وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِنّا عَذابٌ أَليمٌ
transliteration: Qaloo inna tatayyarna bikum lain lam tantahoo lanarjumannakum walayamassannakum minna AAathabun aleemun
translation: (The people of the city) said: We augur ill of you. If ye desist not, we shall surely stone you, and grievous torture will befall you at our hands

arabic: قالوا طٰئِرُكُم مَعَكُم أَئِن ذُكِّرتُم بَل أَنتُم قَومٌ مُسرِفونَ
transliteration: Qaloo tairukum maAAakum ain thukkirtum bal antum qawmun musrifoona
translation: They said: Your evil augury be with you! Is it because ye are reminded (of the truth)? Nay, but ye are froward folk

arabic: وَجاءَ مِن أَقصَا المَدينَةِ رَجُلٌ يَسعىٰ قالَ يٰقَومِ اتَّبِعُوا المُرسَلينَ
transliteration: Wajaa min aqsa almadeenati rajulun yasAAa qala ya qawmi ittabiAAoo almursaleena
translation: And there came from the uttermost part of the city a man running. He cried: O my people! Follow those who have been sent

arabic: اتَّبِعوا مَن لا يَسـَٔلُكُم أَجرًا وَهُم مُهتَدونَ
transliteration: IttabiAAoo man la yasalukum ajran wahum muhtadoona
translation: Follow those who ask of you no fee, and who are rightly guided

arabic: وَما لِىَ لا أَعبُدُ الَّذى فَطَرَنى وَإِلَيهِ تُرجَعونَ
transliteration: Wama liya la aAAbudu allathee fataranee wailayhi turjaAAoona
translation: For what cause should I not serve Him Who hath created me, and unto Whom ye will be brought back

arabic: ءَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دونِهِ ءالِهَةً إِن يُرِدنِ الرَّحمٰنُ بِضُرٍّ لا تُغنِ عَنّى شَفٰعَتُهُم شَيـًٔا وَلا يُنقِذونِ
transliteration: Aattakhithu min doonihi alihatan in yuridni alrrahmanu bidurrin la tughni AAannee shafaAAatuhum shayan wala yunqithooni
translation: Shall I take (other) gods in place of Him when, if the Beneficent should wish me any harm, their intercession will avail me naught, nor can they save

arabic: إِنّى إِذًا لَفى ضَلٰلٍ مُبينٍ
transliteration: Innee ithan lafee dalalin mubeenin
translation: Then truly I should be in error manifest

arabic: إِنّى ءامَنتُ بِرَبِّكُم فَاسمَعونِ
transliteration: Innee amantu birabbikum faismaAAooni
translation: Lo! I have believed in your Lord, so hear me

arabic: قيلَ ادخُلِ الجَنَّةَ قالَ يٰلَيتَ قَومى يَعلَمونَ
transliteration: Qeela odkhuli aljannata qala ya layta qawmee yaAAlamoona
translation: It was said (unto him): Enter paradise. He said: Would that my people knew

arabic: بِما غَفَرَ لى رَبّى وَجَعَلَنى مِنَ المُكرَمينَ
transliteration: Bima ghafara lee rabbee wajaAAalanee mina almukrameena
translation: With what (munificence) my Lord hath pardoned me and made me of the honoured ones

arabic: وَما أَنزَلنا عَلىٰ قَومِهِ مِن بَعدِهِ مِن جُندٍ مِنَ السَّماءِ وَما كُنّا مُنزِلينَ
transliteration: Wama anzalna AAala qawmihi min baAAdihi min jundin mina alssamai wama kunna munzileena
translation: We sent not down against his people after him a host from heaven, nor do We ever send

arabic: إِن كانَت إِلّا صَيحَةً وٰحِدَةً فَإِذا هُم خٰمِدونَ
transliteration: In kanat illa sayhatan wahidatan faitha hum khamidoona
translation: It was but one Shout, and lo! they were extinct

arabic: يٰحَسرَةً عَلَى العِبادِ ما يَأتيهِم مِن رَسولٍ إِلّا كانوا بِهِ يَستَهزِءونَ
transliteration: Ya hasratan AAala alAAibadi ma yateehim min rasoolin illa kanoo bihi yastahzioona
translation: Ah, the anguish for the bondmen! Never came there unto them a messenger but they did mock him

arabic: أَلَم يَرَوا كَم أَهلَكنا قَبلَهُم مِنَ القُرونِ أَنَّهُم إِلَيهِم لا يَرجِعونَ
transliteration: Alam yaraw kam ahlakna qablahum mina alqurooni annahum ilayhim la yarjiAAoona
translation: Have they not seen how many generations We destroyed before them, which indeed returned not unto them

arabic: وَإِن كُلٌّ لَمّا جَميعٌ لَدَينا مُحضَرونَ
transliteration: Wain kullun lamma jameeAAun ladayna muhdaroona
translation: But all, without exception, will be brought before Us

arabic: وَءايَةٌ لَهُمُ الأَرضُ المَيتَةُ أَحيَينٰها وَأَخرَجنا مِنها حَبًّا فَمِنهُ يَأكُلونَ
transliteration: Waayatun lahumu alardu almaytatu ahyaynaha waakhrajna minha habban faminhu yakuloona
translation: A token unto them is the dead earth. We revive it, and We bring forth from it grain so that they eat thereof

arabic: وَجَعَلنا فيها جَنّٰتٍ مِن نَخيلٍ وَأَعنٰبٍ وَفَجَّرنا فيها مِنَ العُيونِ
transliteration: WajaAAalna feeha jannatin min nakheelin waaAAnabin wafajjarna feeha mina alAAuyooni
translation: And We have placed therein gardens of the date-palm and grapes, and We have caused springs of water to gush forth therein

arabic: لِيَأكُلوا مِن ثَمَرِهِ وَما عَمِلَتهُ أَيديهِم أَفَلا يَشكُرونَ
transliteration: Liyakuloo min thamarihi wama AAamilathu aydeehim afala yashkuroona
translation: That they may eat of the fruit thereof, and their hands made it not. Will they not, then, give thanks

arabic: سُبحٰنَ الَّذى خَلَقَ الأَزوٰجَ كُلَّها مِمّا تُنبِتُ الأَرضُ وَمِن أَنفُسِهِم وَمِمّا لا يَعلَمونَ
transliteration: Subhana allathee khalaqa alazwaja kullaha mimma tunbitu alardu wamin anfusihim wamimma la yaAAlamoona
translation: Glory be to Him Who created all the sexual pairs, of that which the earth groweth, and of themselves, and of that which they know not

arabic: وَءايَةٌ لَهُمُ الَّيلُ نَسلَخُ مِنهُ النَّهارَ فَإِذا هُم مُظلِمونَ
transliteration: Waayatun lahumu allaylu naslakhu minhu alnnahara faitha hum muthlimoona
translation: A token unto them is night. We strip it of the day, and lo! they are in darkness

arabic: وَالشَّمسُ تَجرى لِمُستَقَرٍّ لَها ذٰلِكَ تَقديرُ العَزيزِ العَليمِ
transliteration: Waalshshamsu tajree limustaqarrin laha thalika taqdeeru alAAazeezi alAAaleemi
translation: And the sun runneth on unto a resting-place for him. That is the measuring of the Mighty, the Wise

arabic: وَالقَمَرَ قَدَّرنٰهُ مَنازِلَ حَتّىٰ عادَ كَالعُرجونِ القَديمِ
transliteration: Waalqamara qaddarnahu manazila hatta AAada kaalAAurjooni alqadeemi
translation: And for the moon We have appointed mansions till she return like an old shrivelled palm-leaf

arabic: لَا الشَّمسُ يَنبَغى لَها أَن تُدرِكَ القَمَرَ وَلَا الَّيلُ سابِقُ النَّهارِ وَكُلٌّ فى فَلَكٍ يَسبَحونَ
transliteration: La alshshamsu yanbaghee laha an tudrika alqamara wala allaylu sabiqu alnnahari wakullun fee falakin yasbahoona
translation: It is not for the sun to overtake the moon, nor doth the night outstrip the day. They float each in an orbit

arabic: وَءايَةٌ لَهُم أَنّا حَمَلنا ذُرِّيَّتَهُم فِى الفُلكِ المَشحونِ
transliteration: Waayatun lahum anna hamalna thurriyyatahum fee alfulki almashhooni
translation: And a token unto them is that We bear their offspring in the laden ship

arabic: وَخَلَقنا لَهُم مِن مِثلِهِ ما يَركَبونَ
transliteration: Wakhalaqna lahum min mithlihi ma yarkaboona
translation: And have created for them of the like thereof whereon they ride

arabic: وَإِن نَشَأ نُغرِقهُم فَلا صَريخَ لَهُم وَلا هُم يُنقَذونَ
transliteration: Wain nasha nughriqhum fala sareekha lahum wala hum yunqathoona
translation: And if We will, We drown them, and there is no help for them, neither can they be saved

arabic: إِلّا رَحمَةً مِنّا وَمَتٰعًا إِلىٰ حينٍ
transliteration: Illa rahmatan minna wamataAAan ila heenin
translation: Unless by mercy from Us and as comfort for a while

arabic: وَإِذا قيلَ لَهُمُ اتَّقوا ما بَينَ أَيديكُم وَما خَلفَكُم لَعَلَّكُم تُرحَمونَ
transliteration: Waitha qeela lahumu ittaqoo ma bayna aydeekum wama khalfakum laAAallakum turhamoona
translation: When it is said unto them: Beware of that which is before you and that which is behind you, that haply ye may find mercy (they are heedless)

arabic: وَما تَأتيهِم مِن ءايَةٍ مِن ءايٰتِ رَبِّهِم إِلّا كانوا عَنها مُعرِضينَ
transliteration: Wama tateehim min ayatin min ayati rabbihim illa kanoo AAanha muAArideena
translation: Never came a token of the tokens of their Lord to them, but they did turn away from it

arabic: وَإِذا قيلَ لَهُم أَنفِقوا مِمّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللَّهُ قالَ الَّذينَ كَفَروا لِلَّذينَ ءامَنوا أَنُطعِمُ مَن لَو يَشاءُ اللَّهُ أَطعَمَهُ إِن أَنتُم إِلّا فى ضَلٰلٍ مُبينٍ
transliteration: Waitha qeela lahum anfiqoo mimma razaqakumu Allahu qala allatheena kafaroo lillatheena amanoo anutAAimu man law yashao Allahu atAAamahu in antum illa fee dalalin mubeenin
translation: And when it is said unto them: Spend of that wherewith Allah hath provided you, those who disbelieve say unto those who believe: Shall we feed those whom Allah, if He willed, would feed? Ye are in naught else than error manifest

arabic: وَيَقولونَ مَتىٰ هٰذَا الوَعدُ إِن كُنتُم صٰدِقينَ
transliteration: Wayaqooloona mata hatha alwaAAdu in kuntum sadiqeena
translation: And they say: When will this promise be fulfilled, if ye are truthful

arabic: ما يَنظُرونَ إِلّا صَيحَةً وٰحِدَةً تَأخُذُهُم وَهُم يَخِصِّمونَ
transliteration: Ma yanthuroona illa sayhatan wahidatan takhuthuhum wahum yakhissimoona
translation: They await but one Shout, which will surprise them while they are disputing

arabic: فَلا يَستَطيعونَ تَوصِيَةً وَلا إِلىٰ أَهلِهِم يَرجِعونَ
transliteration: Fala yastateeAAoona tawsiyatan wala ila ahlihim yarjiAAoona
translation: Then they cannot make bequest, nor can they return to their own folk

arabic: وَنُفِخَ فِى الصّورِ فَإِذا هُم مِنَ الأَجداثِ إِلىٰ رَبِّهِم يَنسِلونَ
transliteration: Wanufikha fee alssoori faitha hum mina alajdathi ila rabbihim yansiloona
translation: And the trumpet is blown and lo! from the graves they hie unto their Lord

arabic: قالوا يٰوَيلَنا مَن بَعَثَنا مِن مَرقَدِنا هٰذا ما وَعَدَ الرَّحمٰنُ وَصَدَقَ المُرسَلونَ
transliteration: Qaloo ya waylana man baAAathana min marqadina hatha ma waAAada alrrahmanu wasadaqa almursaloona
translation: Crying: Woe upon us! Who hath raised us from our place of sleep? This is that which the Beneficent did promise, and the messengers spoke truth

arabic: إِن كانَت إِلّا صَيحَةً وٰحِدَةً فَإِذا هُم جَميعٌ لَدَينا مُحضَرونَ
transliteration: In kanat illa sayhatan wahidatan faitha hum jameeAAun ladayna muhdaroona
translation: It is but one Shout, and behold them brought together before Us

arabic: فَاليَومَ لا تُظلَمُ نَفسٌ شَيـًٔا وَلا تُجزَونَ إِلّا ما كُنتُم تَعمَلونَ
transliteration: Faalyawma la tuthlamu nafsun shayan wala tujzawna illa ma kuntum taAAmaloona
translation: This day no soul is wronged in aught; nor are ye requited aught save what ye used to do

arabic: إِنَّ أَصحٰبَ الجَنَّةِ اليَومَ فى شُغُلٍ فٰكِهونَ
transliteration: Inna ashaba aljannati alyawma fee shughulin fakihoona
translation: Lo! those who merit paradise this day are happily employed

arabic: هُم وَأَزوٰجُهُم فى ظِلٰلٍ عَلَى الأَرائِكِ مُتَّكِـٔونَ
transliteration: Hum waazwajuhum fee thilalin AAala alaraiki muttakioona
translation: They and their wives, in pleasant shade, on thrones reclining

arabic: لَهُم فيها فٰكِهَةٌ وَلَهُم ما يَدَّعونَ
transliteration: Lahum feeha fakihatun walahum ma yaddaAAoona
translation: Theirs the fruit (of their good deeds) and theirs (all) that they ask

arabic: سَلٰمٌ قَولًا مِن رَبٍّ رَحيمٍ
transliteration: Salamun qawlan min rabbin raheemin
translation: The word from a Merciful Lord (for them) is: Peace

arabic: وَامتٰزُوا اليَومَ أَيُّهَا المُجرِمونَ
transliteration: Waimtazoo alyawma ayyuha almujrimoona
translation: But avaunt ye, O ye guilty, this day

arabic: أَلَم أَعهَد إِلَيكُم يٰبَنى ءادَمَ أَن لا تَعبُدُوا الشَّيطٰنَ إِنَّهُ لَكُم عَدُوٌّ مُبينٌ
transliteration: Alam aAAhad ilaykum ya banee adama an la taAAbudoo alshshaytana innahu lakum AAaduwwun mubeenun
translation: Did I not charge you, O ye sons of Adam, that ye worship not the devil - Lo! he is your open foe

arabic: وَأَنِ اعبُدونى هٰذا صِرٰطٌ مُستَقيمٌ
transliteration: Waani oAAbudoonee hatha siratun mustaqeemun
translation: But that ye worship Me? That was the right path

arabic: وَلَقَد أَضَلَّ مِنكُم جِبِلًّا كَثيرًا أَفَلَم تَكونوا تَعقِلونَ
transliteration: Walaqad adalla minkum jibillan katheeran afalam takoonoo taAAqiloona
translation: Yet he hath led astray of you a great multitude. Had ye then no sense

arabic: هٰذِهِ جَهَنَّمُ الَّتى كُنتُم توعَدونَ
transliteration: Hathihi jahannamu allatee kuntum tooAAadoona
translation: This is hell which ye were promised (if ye followed him)

arabic: اصلَوهَا اليَومَ بِما كُنتُم تَكفُرونَ
transliteration: Islawha alyawma bima kuntum takfuroona
translation: Burn therein this day for that ye disbelieved

arabic: اليَومَ نَختِمُ عَلىٰ أَفوٰهِهِم وَتُكَلِّمُنا أَيديهِم وَتَشهَدُ أَرجُلُهُم بِما كانوا يَكسِبونَ
transliteration: Alyawma nakhtimu AAala afwahihim watukallimuna aydeehim watashhadu arjuluhum bima kanoo yaksiboona
translation: This day We seal up their mouths, and their hands speak out to Us and their feet bear witness as to what they used to earn

arabic: وَلَو نَشاءُ لَطَمَسنا عَلىٰ أَعيُنِهِم فَاستَبَقُوا الصِّرٰطَ فَأَنّىٰ يُبصِرونَ
transliteration: Walaw nashao latamasna AAala aAAyunihim faistabaqoo alssirata faanna yubsiroona
translation: And had We willed, We verily could have quenched their eyesight so that they should struggle for the way. Then how could they have seen

arabic: وَلَو نَشاءُ لَمَسَخنٰهُم عَلىٰ مَكانَتِهِم فَمَا استَطٰعوا مُضِيًّا وَلا يَرجِعونَ
transliteration: Walaw nashao lamasakhnahum AAala makanatihim fama istataAAoo mudiyyan wala yarjiAAoona
translation: And had We willed, We verily could have fixed them in their place, making them powerless to go forward or turn back

arabic: وَمَن نُعَمِّرهُ نُنَكِّسهُ فِى الخَلقِ أَفَلا يَعقِلونَ
transliteration: Waman nuAAammirhu nunakkishu fee alkhalqi afala yaAAqiloona
translation: He whom we bring unto old age, We reverse him in creation (making him go back to weakness after strength). Have ye then no sense

arabic: وَما عَلَّمنٰهُ الشِّعرَ وَما يَنبَغى لَهُ إِن هُوَ إِلّا ذِكرٌ وَقُرءانٌ مُبينٌ
transliteration: Wama AAallamnahu alshshiAAra wama yanbaghee lahu in huwa illa thikrun waquranun mubeenun
translation: And We have not taught him (Muhammad) poetry, nor is it meet for him. This is naught else than a Reminder and a Lecture making plain

arabic: لِيُنذِرَ مَن كانَ حَيًّا وَيَحِقَّ القَولُ عَلَى الكٰفِرينَ
transliteration: Liyunthira man kana hayyan wayahiqqa alqawlu AAala alkafireena
translation: To warn whosoever liveth, and that the word may be fulfilled against the disbelievers

arabic: أَوَلَم يَرَوا أَنّا خَلَقنا لَهُم مِمّا عَمِلَت أَيدينا أَنعٰمًا فَهُم لَها مٰلِكونَ
transliteration: Awalam yaraw anna khalaqna lahum mimma AAamilat aydeena anAAaman fahum laha malikoona
translation: Have they not seen how We have created for them of Our handiwork the cattle, so that they are their owners

arabic: وَذَلَّلنٰها لَهُم فَمِنها رَكوبُهُم وَمِنها يَأكُلونَ
transliteration: Wathallalnaha lahum faminha rakoobuhum waminha yakuloona
translation: And have subdued them unto them, so that some of them they have for riding, some for food

arabic: وَلَهُم فيها مَنٰفِعُ وَمَشارِبُ أَفَلا يَشكُرونَ
transliteration: Walahum feeha manafiAAu wamasharibu afala yashkuroona
translation: Benefits and (divers) drinks have they from them. Will they not then give thanks

arabic: وَاتَّخَذوا مِن دونِ اللَّهِ ءالِهَةً لَعَلَّهُم يُنصَرونَ
transliteration: Waittakhathoo min dooni Allahi alihatan laAAallahum yunsaroona
translation: And they have taken (other) gods beside Allah, in order that they may be helped

arabic: لا يَستَطيعونَ نَصرَهُم وَهُم لَهُم جُندٌ مُحضَرونَ
transliteration: La yastateeAAoona nasrahum wahum lahum jundun muhdaroona
translation: It is not in their power to help them; but they (the worshippers) are unto them a host in arms

arabic: فَلا يَحزُنكَ قَولُهُم إِنّا نَعلَمُ ما يُسِرّونَ وَما يُعلِنونَ
transliteration: Fala yahzunka qawluhum inna naAAlamu ma yusirroona wama yuAAlinoona
translation: So let not their speech grieve thee (O Muhammad). Lo! We know what they conceal and what proclaim

arabic: أَوَلَم يَرَ الإِنسٰنُ أَنّا خَلَقنٰهُ مِن نُطفَةٍ فَإِذا هُوَ خَصيمٌ مُبينٌ
transliteration: Awalam yara alinsanu anna khalaqnahu min nutfatin faitha huwa khaseemun mubeenun
translation: Hath not man seen that We have created him from a drop of seed? Yet lo! he is an open opponent

arabic: وَضَرَبَ لَنا مَثَلًا وَنَسِىَ خَلقَهُ قالَ مَن يُحىِ العِظٰمَ وَهِىَ رَميمٌ
transliteration: Wadaraba lana mathalan wanasiya khalqahu qala man yuhyee alAAithama wahiya rameemun
translation: And he hath coined for Us a similitude, and hath forgotten the fact of his creation, saying: Who will revive these bones when they have rotted away

arabic: قُل يُحييهَا الَّذى أَنشَأَها أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلقٍ عَليمٌ
transliteration: Qul yuhyeeha allathee anshaaha awwala marratin wahuwa bikulli khalqin AAaleemun
translation: Say: He will revive them Who produced them at the first, for He is Knower of every creation

arabic: الَّذى جَعَلَ لَكُم مِنَ الشَّجَرِ الأَخضَرِ نارًا فَإِذا أَنتُم مِنهُ توقِدونَ
transliteration: Allathee jaAAala lakum mina alshshajari alakhdari naran faitha antum minhu tooqidoona
translation: Who hath appointed for you fire from the green tree, and behold! ye kindle from it

arabic: أَوَلَيسَ الَّذى خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضَ بِقٰدِرٍ عَلىٰ أَن يَخلُقَ مِثلَهُم بَلىٰ وَهُوَ الخَلّٰقُ العَليمُ
transliteration: Awalaysa allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda biqadirin AAala an yakhluqa mithlahum bala wahuwa alkhallaqu alAAaleemu
translation: Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the like of them? Aye, that He is! for He is the All-Wise Creator

arabic: إِنَّما أَمرُهُ إِذا أَرادَ شَيـًٔا أَن يَقولَ لَهُ كُن فَيَكونُ
transliteration: Innama amruhu itha arada shayan an yaqoola lahu kun fayakoonu
translation: But His command, when He intendeth a thing, is only that He saith unto it: Be! and it is

arabic: فَسُبحٰنَ الَّذى بِيَدِهِ مَلَكوتُ كُلِّ شَيءٍ وَإِلَيهِ تُرجَعونَ
transliteration: Fasubhana allathee biyadihi malakootu kulli shayin wailayhi turjaAAoona
translation: Therefor Glory be to Him in Whose hand is the dominion over all things! Unto Him ye will be brought back
